cover.title: D5 M40 fixed rectangular outer cover
cover.construction: 39 lambda bands width 1/200; 8 rho bands width 1/64; 4 z bands each scaled by lambda upper endpoint /32; covers physical wedge by overcoverage at lambda low end
cover.q_cap_method: r_box=sqrt(rho_hi^2+(z_hi/lambda_lo)^2); P=sqrt(rho_hi^2+z_hi^2); F=((1+lambda_hi^2)/2+P)/(lambda_lo*(1-r_box)); q_plus=(F-1)/(F+1); all sqrt upward dyadic 128-bit
